findings.summary: Criterion 4 discriminative test is missing. Spec §2/§5 explicitly requires '判据 2 与 4 的测试必须真正驱动被测对象' and that removing the board-composition output makes a test turn red. The _print_limit_hit implementation exists (bin/e0-regression.sh:349-370 prints 'board composition at limit hit: proposed=<n> open=<m> ...' and names 'TRIAGE THRESHOLD DEADLOCK' when 0<proposed<threshold), but NO test in test/ drives e0-regression.sh's limit-hit path and asserts on the board-composition line or the deadlock-naming line. The existing limit-hit tests (test/e0c2-termination.test.ts:1027-1051) only assert non-zero exit and /HIT ATTEMPT LIMIT/ matching — they never check for 'board composition' or 'TRIAGE THRESHOLD DEADLOCK'. Removing _print_limit_hit entirely would leave every test green. This is exactly the '判别性缺失' the spec classifies as blocker-level (§5: 'REJECT 只用于 blocker 级：...判别性缺失').

Criterion 5 (drain_attempts correctness) has no test. Spec §2 criterion 5 requires 'drain_attempts 与实际 drain 次数一致（上限 12 ⇒ 最多报 12）'. The §1.3 fix is implemented correctly (limit check moved before the increment at bin/e0-regression.sh:392-398, so DRAIN_ATTEMPT never exceeds DRAIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS), but no test asserts the drain_attempts value reported by the script (in run.meta or the 'HIT ATTEMPT LIMIT' line) equals the actual number of drains executed. The existing limit-hit test (test/e0c2-termination.test.ts:1046-1047) reads attemptFile — the fake loop's OWN internal counter — which is independent of the script's DRAIN_ATTEMPT variable. A regression reintroducing the off-by-one (e.g., checking limit after increment, the original bug where max_attempts=12 reported drain_attempts=13) would not turn any test red.

Criterion 2's discriminative test only covers the pure function, not the profile-to-decideTick wiring. test/tick.test.ts:266-270 (B11) calls decideTick directly with a hand-crafted TickConfig{triageThreshold:1}, verifying the threshold mechanism but NOT that the regression profile's TICK_TRIAGE_THRESHOLD=1 actually reaches decideTick through the full chain (profiles/deploy/e0-regression.env → deep-research-loop.sh:117 → fleet.yaml.tpl:20 → tick.md:56 → tick-entry --triage-threshold → parseRunCliArgs → tickConfig). Spec criterion 2 requires the 1-proposed board to advance '在回归 profile 下'. If the wiring broke at any link (e.g., tick.md stopped passing --triage-threshold, or fleet.yaml.tpl stopped interpolating triage_threshold), B11 would stay green while the real regression profile silently reverted to threshold 3 — the original GT-11 deadlock. An end-to-end test driving tick-entry --run (or rendered tick.md) with the profile threshold and asserting a triage decision on a 1-proposed board would close this gap.
